meta.name: actor-profiling
meta.description: Understand who the user is — background, resources, constraints, and deep motivations. Produces an ActorProfile that informs all downstream decisions. Use this tactic at the start of any crystallization process to build a model of the user's capabilities, limitations, and intent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析用户背景、资源与深层动机，生成用户画像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目开始时快速理解用户特征与意图
copy.tagline_en: Analyze user background, resources, and deep motivations to generate a user profile
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand user characteristics and intent at the start of a project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会通过一系列对话了解你的背景、资源、限制和深层动机，并整理成一份“角色档案”（ActorProfile），用于后续的研究建议决策。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新研究项目或请求帮助规划课题时，技能会在初始阶段自动启动，逐步收集你的信息。

say.text: 我学计算机，有两年NLP经验，目标顶会论文。
say.note: Claude会开始收集背景和资源。

say.text: 只有一台笔记本和两个月，不能做实验量大的课题。
最大动机是兴趣，不怕冒险，但不想做化学方向。
say.note: Claude会探索深层动机和边界。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will engage in a series of dialogues to understand your background, resources, constraints, and deep motivations. It will synthesize an ActorProfile to inform downstream decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggers at the start of a crystallization process when you ask for research planning or help defining a project. It activates when you describe your background or request personalized guidance.

say_en.text: I have CS background and two years in NLP. Aiming for top conference paper.
Only a laptop and two months. Cannot do heavy experiments.
Motivated by interest, risk-tolerant, avoid chemistry.
